description: This Java source file provides a backward-compatible utility class for handling scale gestures using ScaleGestureDetector. It offers static methods to retrieve current span values in the X and Y directions, abstracting API level differences.

classes.name: ScaleGestureDetectorCompat
classes.description: A utility class for providing backward compatibility support for ScaleGestureDetector span methods.

methods.name: getCurrentSpanX
methods.description: Returns the current horizontal span of a scale gesture, with compatibility handling for different API levels.

methods.name: getCurrentSpanY
methods.description: Returns the current vertical span of a scale gesture, with compatibility handling for different API levels.
